domain-information: A Zoo Keeper feeds an animal according to the care schedule assigned by the veterinary team.
A Zoo Keeper updates the animal care log.
A Zoo Keeper alerts the Veterinarian when an animal’s behavior deviates from normal patterns.
A Veterinarian conducts a scheduled health examination for an animal.
A Veterinarian issues a treatment plan for the keepers to follow during recovery.
A Veterinarian updates the medical record so management can track long-term health outcomes.
A Facility Coordinator receives a maintenance request from a keeper and contacts a habitat technician.
A Habitat Technician performs repairs to ensure the enclosure meets safety and regulatory standards.
A Habitat Technician reports completed maintenance to the facility coordinator for documentation.
An Education Coordinator plans a public presentation using animal information provided by the keepers.
An Education Coordinator prepares a guided tour schedule approved by the visitor services supervisor.
A Visitor Services Associate sells tickets according to pricing guidelines set by administration.
A Visitor Services Associate processes a membership application and forwards records to the member database team.

associations.description: Zoo Keeper performs Feeding.
Feeding is carried out for the Animal.
Zoo Keeper updates the Care Log.
Zoo Keeper creates a Behaviour Alert.
Behaviour Alert is sent to the Veterinarian.
Veterinarian assigns the Care Schedule.
Veterinarian updates the Medical Record.
Veterinarian performs the Health Examination.
Health Examination is conducted on the Animal.
Veterinarian creates the Treatment Plan.
Zoo Keeper follows the Treatment Plan.
Zoo Keeper submits a Maintenance Request.
Maintenance Request is received by the Facility Coordinator.
Facility Coordinator assigns work to the Habitat Technician.
Habitat Technician performs the Habitat Repair.
Habitat Repair is applied to the Habitat.
Habitat Technician creates a Maintenance Report.
Maintenance Report is sent to the Facility Coordinator.
Education Coordinator prepares the Public Presentation.
Zoo Keeper provides information for the Public Presentation.
Education Coordinator creates the Guided Tour Schedule.
Visitor Services Associate uses the Guided Tour Schedule.
Visitor Services Associate processes the Ticket Sale.
Visitor Services Associate accepts the Membership Application.
Membership Application is forwarded to the Member Database Team.
